The landslide was triggered by heavy rainfall at 4:55 am. Chitwan's Traffic Police Chief, Inspector Santosh Pant, said excavators have been used to remove the landslide debris. नारायणगढ–मुग्लिन सडकखण्ड अन्तर्गत तुइन खोलामा फेरि पहिरो खसेपछि सडक दुवै तर्फबाट अवरुद्ध भएको छ। इच्छाकामना गाउँपालिका–५ स्थित तुइन खोलामा मंगलबार साँझ ७ः३० बजेतिर माथिबाट लेदो सहितको पहिरो खस्दा सडक अवरुद्ध भएको हो। इलाका प्रहरी कार्यालय मुग्लिनका प्रहरी निरीक्षक प्रतीक सिंहका अनुसार, पहिरो हटाउन आवश्यक मेसिन र प्राविधिकहरू स्थलतर्फ पठाइएको छ।

Resize Text Size Small Medium Large Listen File Photo File Photo By Republica SINDHULI, Sept 7: The Khurkot-Ghurmi road section along the Mid-Hill Highway has been obstructed due to landslides.

Dry landslide occurred at Golanjor Rural Municipality-1, Kudule in Sindhuli had disrupted the highway.

Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP) at the District Police Office, Bimal Raj Kandel shared that vehicular movement was completely halted on the road section after landslide continued to occur since 4 AM on Wednesday.

Vehicles plying through the mid-hill highway from eastern mountainous districts have been stranded on the road after highway disruption, he added.

A team of the Area Police Office, Khurkot is now removing landslide debris to bring back the traffic. Locals have joined hands to clear off the road, he informed.

"Landslides continue to take place since early this morning," said Vice-Chairperson of Golanjar Rural Municipality, Jwala Prasad Neupane.

Hundreds of passengers have been stranded along the road.

NARAYANGADH, April 3: The landslide, which killed two, at Ghumaune of Muglin-Narayangadh road stretch has been cleared now. However, the vehicular movement is prohibited on the road as the risk of landslide still looms large at the place.

The landslide buried nine vehicles, including five motorbikes, at 10 am on Monday. Two person were killed while two others sustained injuries as the landslide hit the road. Nine vehicles -one tanker, one truck, one mini truck, one car and five motorbikes –have been buried in the landslide.

One of the deceased has been identified as the assistant driver of the tanker, Na 4 Kha 5419, bound for Narayangadh, according to the Home Ministry. Two injured persons have been rushed to Bharatpur for treatment.

Earlier, DPM Bimalendra Nidhi instructed all the concerned security personnel to get involved in the rescue.

The rescue team comprising members from all of the three security forces - Nepal Army, Nepal Police and Armed Nepal Police has reached the incident site, informed Press Advisor of DPM Ramji Dahal.

TEXT:
POKHARA: A teenage boy died after he was buried under the rubble of a house destroyed by a landslide that occurred in Jaljala Rural Municipality-8 of Parbat district on Tuesday night.

The landslide triggered by incessant rain at Lasti Berneta completely destroyed two houses, at around 1:00 am today, according to Parbat's Chief District officer (CDO) Gurudatta Dhakal.

The security personnel deployed from Milanchok-based police post, with the help of local residents recovered the body of 16-year-old Bikash Pariyar and handed over to his family members, at around 4:00 am today. Other family members residing in the two houses escaped the calamity in time.

It has been noted that the whole village is at the risk of landslides as it lies on the slope, just below the hill, and between two streams flowing downwards from the hill.

TEXT:
नागरिक अभिलेखालय

काठमाडौं - चीनसंगको मूख्य व्यापारिक नाका पासाङ ल्हामू राजमार्ग पहिरोका कारण अवरुद्ध भएपछि नजिकिएको चार्डपर्वलाई असर पर्ने देखिएको छ। चार्डपर्व लक्षित सामान ढुवानी गर्ने सयौ कन्टेनर बाटैमा अलपत्र परेका छन। बाटो तत्काल खुलाउन नसकिए नजिकिएको चार्डपर्वमा मूल्य वृद्धि तथा सामाग्रीको अभाव हुने सम्भावना देखिएको हो।

गत बुधवार साँझ उक्त राजमर्ग अन्तरगत रसुवाको कालिका गाउँपालिका–१, नागुर्दुनमा पहिरोले सडक भत्काएपछि सवारी सञ्चालन पूर्णरुपमा अवरुद्ध भएको हो। पहिरोका कारण मानिस हिँड्ने बाटो समेत छैन। उक्त स्थानमा २५ मिटर सडक भासिएको छ।

‘हाम्रा सयौं कन्टेनर बाटैमा अलपत्र परेका छन्’ व्यवसायि राजेन्द्र दुलाल भन्छन्,‘पहिरोका कारण व्यवसायी ठूलो मर्कामा परेका छन्।’ उनले अलपत्र परेका अधिकांश माल सामान बाहक सवारी दशैतिहार लक्षित रहेको जानकारी दिए।

‘तीन सय जति कन्टेनर बाटोमा छन्, बाटो कहिले खुल्ने हो अझै थाहा छैन’, उनले भने। पहिरोका कारण सामान्य आवतजावत गर्नसमेत समस्या उत्पन्न भएको छ। कडा चट्टानका कारण भित्तो फुटाएर बाटो खोल्ने अवस्था नभएकोले जगै देखि बाटो भर्नुपर्ने देखिन्छ।

यता जिल्ला प्रशासान कार्यलय रसुवाले भने बाटो खुलाउने प्रयास जारी रहेको जानकारी दिएको छ। ‘हामीले तारजालीको काम सुरु गरिसकेका छौ’, रसुवाकी निमित्त प्रमुख जिल्ला अधिकारी सपनाकुमारी भट्टराईले नागरिकन्यूजसंग भनिन्,‘अब चार दिन भित्रबाटो खुलाउने प्रयास गर्नेछौं।’ उनले बाटो अवरुद्धका कारण सयौं व्यवसायी मर्कामा परेको स्वीकार गरिन्।

‘पासाङ ल्हामु सडक सञ्चालन गर्न नसकिए विकल्पका रुपमा गल्छी, त्रिशुली, मैलुङ, स्याप्रुवेशी सडकखण्ड सञ्चालन गर्नेछौं’ निप्रजिअ भट्टराईले भनिन्,‘चार दिनभित्र २५ मिटर पहिरो पुर्न सकिन्छ भन्ने हाम्रो विश्वास हो।’ तर गल्छी, त्रिशुली, मैलुङ, स्याप्रुवेशी सडकखण्ड पनि ठाँउठाउँमा पहिरो गएका कारण तत्काल सञ्चालनको अवस्था छैन। उक्त सडकखण्ड पनि खुलाउन प्रयास भैरहेको उनले बताइन।

चीनबाट विषेशगरि लत्ताकपडा, विद्युतीय उपकरण, निर्माण समाग्री आयात हुने गर्छन। समयमै बाटो खुलाउन नसकिए त्यस्ता समाग्रीको मूल्य वृद्धि समेत हुनसक्ने व्यवसायीहरु बताउँछन्। बाटोे अवरुद्धका कारण चार्डपर्वमा सामाग्रीको अभाव हुने भएकाले मुल्यवृद्धिको सम्भावना उतिक्कै रहेको छ।

विनाशकारी भूकम्पछि चीनसंगको मूख्य व्यापारिक नाकाको रुपमा रहेको अरनिको राजमार्ग पूर्णरुपमा सञ्चानलनमा आउन सकेको छैन। तातोपानी नाकाको विकल्पका रुपमा पासाङ ल्हामु मार्ग सञ्चालन हँुदै आएको छ। पछिल्लो वर्षहरुमा यहि मार्गले चीनसंगको ठूलो व्यापारिक हिस्सा धान्दै आएको छ।

TEXT:
सुख्खा पहिरो खसेपछि नारायणगढ–मुग्लिन सडक एकतर्फी मात्र सञ्चालनमा आएको छ। शनिबार राति ८ः३० बजे भरतपुर महानगरपालिका भरतपुर २९ सत्रकिलोस्थित खानी खोला पुलनजिक सुख्खा पहिरो खसेको हो।

पहिरो खसेपछि अहिले गन्तव्यमा हिँडेका सवारीसाधनको लाइन लागेको छ।

सडक डिभिजन कार्यालयसँग समन्वय गरेर पहिरो पन्छाउने काम सुरू गरिने इलाका प्रहरी कार्यालय मुग्लिनले जानकारी दिएको छ।

बिहीबार मात्रै भरतपुर महानगरपालिका–२९ स्थित केराबारी र अठार किलोमा पहिरो खसेर सडक अवरूद्ध भएको थियो।

यो वर्ष मात्रै दुई दर्जनभन्दा धेरै पटक पहिरो खसेर नारायणगढ–मुग्लिन सडक अवरूद्ध भएको छ।

Chitwan, July 24

Yet another landslide has blocked the Narayangadh-Muglin road in Chitwan on Friday morning.

The road connecting Kathmandu with the East-West Highway has been blocked at Charkilo, Ichhakamana rural municipality-6 of Chitwan, according to the District Police Office.

Earlier this week, another landslide around the same location had blocked the road. Security personnel had removed the debris to resume one-way transport just yesterday.

DSP Surya Bahadur Thapa of the District Police Office says the landslide is still going on, hence the severity of the incident might be bigger. Likewise, he says the authorities are not sure when the road reopens.

The road gets frequently blocked every monsoon due to different landslides of different magnitude.

TEXT:

BAGLUNG, Mar 5: A section of the mid-hill highway in Manewa of Righa VDC in Baglung district was obstructed due to a landslide on Sunday morning. It has also blocked the Daram river and turned it into a lake.

The landslide also brought down seven electricity poles of the central transmission grid. The early-morning disaster that struck at around 5:30 am caused the death of a woman, who was electrocuted when a pole fell upon her. The deceased has been identified as Mana Kumari Nepali. Although she was taken to a local hospital after the incident, unfortunately she succumbed to her injuries.

According to Anil Kumar Khadka, spokesperson of District Police Office, Baglung, the road was obstructed when a mass of land fell down from 150 meter above, obstructing 200 meters of the highway.

“The landslide has even created a 150-meter long lake, which is 15 meters deep by blocking the Daram khola,” said Khadka. He further informed that water has started overflowing from the lake, effectively minimizing the risks of outburst and inundation.

According to Badri Sharma, chief division engineer at the mid-hill highway in Baglung, the 'dry landslide' was a result of the digging of land along the highway for laying pipes to produce energy by the Daramkhola Hydroelectricity Project Limited.

“When they asked for permission, we had told them to lay pipes toward the cliff as the edge of the highway was quite steep, ” said Sharma. He informed that clearing the rocks and land will take some time. “I have already asked the construction companies and Hydropower project working in along the highway to fix the problem and they assured to make the highway ready in about five-six days,” said Sharma.

Chief District Officer of Baglung, Bhagirath Pandey, has instructed a team of police and army for observation and also to clean the landslide.

“We have already sent Nepal Police and Nepal Army personnel from Ghodabadhe and now we will be taking steps as per their reporting,” said CDO Pandey. He also added that the district administration office has instructed other concerned authorities to resume transportation as soon as possible.

CHITWAN: A landslide that occurred at Char Kilo of Ichchhakamana Rural Municipality-6 of Chitwan district has obstructed vehicular movement along the Narayangadh-Muglin road section, today.

Continuous rainfall triggered the heavy landslip that covered the road section with debris at around 5:00 am, informed Shiva Khanal, engineer at Narayangadh-Muglin Road Project. The landslide also swept away two electric poles, he added.
